excluded_detectors.reason: Getters of immutables and constants keep the SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE name of the value they expose (HUB(), ADAPTER(), RESCUE_MIN_PLEDGE_USD()), as Aave V4 and OpenZeppelin name them; naming is not a security property.
Which event fields are indexed is fixed by the spec's event definitions and the indexer's topic layout, not chosen per detector.

accepted.reason: Intended inversion, not lost precision: for a positive tick `type(uint256).max / price` inverts the Q128.128 ratio exactly as Uniswap v4-core TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick does (Slither pairs it with the table products above it on the same variable); the result is rounded up to Q64.96 afterwards. Covered by TEST-279 (tickBoundsMatchUniswap, tickAtSqrtRatioInvertsSqrtRatioAtTick) and the TEST-037 differential suite (tickMapMatchesReference).
accepted.review: Replaces a2b58ce48cdc5468 (ClPriceMath.sqrtRatioAtTick, approved by Avana Labs 2026-11-10 by pattern): the tick math moved into the MIT ClTickMath (v4-core TickMath), which ClPriceMath.sqrtRatioAtTick now calls.

accepted.reason: getSqrtPriceAtTick is Uniswap v4-core TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick: one branch per bit of |tick| over the magic-constant table, kept line for line so it can be compared with the audited original; splitting it would only hide the table. forge-lint suppression on the function with the same reason. Covered by TEST-279 (tickBoundsMatchUniswap) and the TEST-037 differential suite (tickMapMatchesReference).
accepted.review: Replaces d1115e0b28e5b4e8 (ClPriceMath.sqrtRatioAtTick, approved by Avana Labs 2026-11-10 by pattern): the same table, now in ClTickMath.
